recommendation.rationale: Generic Solar is missing 6 of 7 F1 Reference criteria. Dominant gaps: no Excel reference; no parity computation; no KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md; no dedicated test pack; no per-project D1/D2 redo/D3 redo audit posture. Technical 30/100 (NOT READY); Validation 0/100 (NOT READY); Governance 87/100 (PARTIAL — strong for an exploratory project). Generic Solar should remain at Level 1 (Exploratory / Unvalidated). F2-C / F2-D / F2-E is the right next step. Note: Generic Solar has 0 data discrepancies between factory and Phase 34 doc (positive finding relative to Generic Wind which has 3). Option B (limited preparation) and Option C (controlled Reference program) are not appropriate at this time.
